= Install the SDK
:type: how-to
:description: Get the SDK onto a machine.

Everything below assumes a clean machine.

[[prereq]]
== Prerequisites

Node 24 or later. See xref:configuration.adoc#keys[the keys].

[source,bash]
----
npm install sdk
----
